mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market weakness triggering anticipated Fed rate cuts, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as equity valuations adjust to lower discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of UNRATE >4.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise indicate active monetary easing amid labor market deterioration, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal fails to produce positive returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP growth (GDPC1 >19000) indicates robust economic expansion supporting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as valuation multiples stabilize.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >55% of GDPC1 >19000 periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth over 3 months signals strong economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >55% of INDPRO growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300 thousand units signal weakening demand, triggering immediate equity sell-offs as recession risks rise, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >55% of HOUST <1300 periods, or Rank IC > -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST decline and INDPRO drop indicate broad economic slowdown, increasing recession probability and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal fails to produce negative returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC > 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 260 indicates persistent high inflation, prompting anticipated Fed rate hikes that pressure equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL >260 periods, or Rank IC > -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
